inspiration.observed_pattern: A correlated UPDATE rebuilds one missing JSON array from one legacy object through JSON_TABLE, JSON_SET, and JSON_ARRAYAGG.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one independently authored profile and one object item while retaining the correlated JSON_TABLE update and JSON array reconstruction.

fixture_notes: One profile has one legacy object and no target items field, isolating the failing correlated JSON_TABLE aggregate update.
determinism_notes: The profile ID, JSON document, and final ordering are fixed. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE mini_migration_profiles (profile_id INT PRIMARY KEY, profile JSON NOT NULL)

steps.sql: UPDATE mini_migration_profiles AS p SET profile = JSON_SET(profile, '$.items', COALESCE((SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_SET(item_row.item_json, '$.migrated', TRUE) ORDER BY item_row.position) FROM JSON_TABLE(CASE WHEN JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.profile, '$.pendingItems')) = 'ARRAY' THEN JSON_EXTRACT(p.profile, '$.pendingItems') ELSE JSON_ARRAY() END, '$[*]' COLUMNS (position FOR ORDINALITY, item_json JSON PATH '$')) AS item_row WHERE JSON_TYPE(item_row.item_json) = 'OBJECT'), JSON_ARRAY())) WHERE JSON_CONTAINS_PATH(profile, 'one', '$.pendingItems') AND NOT JSON_CONTAINS_PATH(profile, 'one', '$.items')

checks.sql: SELECT profile_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(profile, '$.items')) AS items FROM mini_migration_profiles ORDER BY profile_id
